time_policy: Estimated guided learning time, including alternative video/transcript, reading and exercises. Quiz: 12 minutes within 3.5; formative practice: 8 within 2.4; final practice: 12 within 4.4. Do not add these again. Validate with learners before claiming measured completion time.
localisation_notes: US small-business repair-shop workflow; account executive terminology; USD quote-basis checks; US commercial-email reference. No assumption of uniform state law or universal buying behaviour.

aulas.titulo: What selling means: needs, solutions and value

roteiro_video.fala_instrutor: Think of a sales conversation as a decision about change. Your job is to help a buyer evaluate whether that change is worth making. In our fictional case, Cedar Auto in Ohio wants to track work orders. We do not yet know whether the difficulty is duplicate entries, missing parts or unclear responsibilities. Start by asking how a recent order moved through the shop. Then confirm the difficulty before discussing a product. A seller can do useful work by recognising that the offer does not fit. Pause here and replace “we will grow your revenue” with a question that would test relevance.
roteiro_video.gravacao: Not recorded; deliver as a short lesson with explicit exercise pauses.
roteiro_video.tela: What selling means: needs, solutions and value

aulas.texto_apoio: Separate a feature, a possible benefit and buyer-confirmed value. A dashboard is a feature. Bringing orders together is a possible benefit. Whether that helps enough to justify cost and implementation depends on the buyer. The alternative may be an existing process rather than another vendor. Record current situation, confirmed difficulty, consequence and desired change. Mark an untested statement as a hypothesis. Do not estimate savings unless the inputs and assumptions are available, and do not present potential savings as guaranteed cash or income.

exemplo.conteudo: Cedar Auto uses paper and email. Its owner wants fewer duplicate entries. Frequency, cost and buying process are unknown.

instrucoes: List two confirmed facts, two unknowns, a neutral discovery question and a conditional value hypothesis.
exercicio.entrega: Written response using only fictional details.
exercicio.gabarito: Facts: paper/email and desire to reduce duplicate entries. Unknowns: frequency and decision process. Ask where duplication happens. Hypothesis: a shared record may help staff compare entries; test it before recommending.
exercicio.justificativa: The answer identifies what the buyer actually reported, keeps unmeasured impact separate and tests a conditional benefit rather than guaranteeing it.

tempo_estimado.observacao: Estimate for learner pilot. Video and transcript are alternatives; do not count both.

aulas.objetivo: List two confirmed facts, two unknowns, a neutral discovery question and a conditional value hypothesis.

checagem.pergunta: The workshop reports difficulty, but you have not confirmed its cause. What next?
alternativas: Send a contract.
Investigate a recent example before recommending.
Guarantee increased sales.
checagem.feedback: A recent example tests the cause. The reported difficulty is not evidence that your product fits.

roteiro_video.fala_instrutor: A software subscription, account setup and data migration are different commitments. At Cedar Auto, the owner assumes setup means someone will type every old work order into the system. Our fictional package does not include that service. Explain the boundary before asking for agreement. On screen, list what is included, what is excluded, who supplies inputs and how delivery will be checked. This is also where you confirm whether a quoted amount is one-time or recurring, rather than letting the buyer infer it. Pause and describe an observable acceptance test.
roteiro_video.gravacao: Not recorded; deliver as a short lesson with explicit exercise pauses.

aulas.texto_apoio: An offer may combine a product, execution services and several coordinated components. Classify the components to clarify responsibilities, not to rank their sophistication. A measurable acceptance condition might require two test accounts to complete an agreed workflow. That checks delivery; it does not guarantee revenue, universal adoption or an error-free operation. Explain dependencies, recurring commitments and material exclusions before agreement. If pricing, tax treatment or a contract term is not provided, refer it to the authorised owner rather than inventing a rule.

exemplo.conteudo: Fictional package: 12 months of access, two configured accounts and one training session. Historical paper entry is excluded. No tax treatment is specified.

instrucoes: Identify the components, explain one exclusion and write an acceptance condition for setup.
exercicio.entrega: Written response using only fictional details.
exercicio.gabarito: Product access plus setup/training services. State that historical paper entry is excluded. Verify that both test accounts can complete the agreed order workflow; leave tax and recurring terms for confirmation.
exercicio.justificativa: The acceptance test is limited to a deliverable that can be observed. It does not expand setup into migration, language support or a financial guarantee.

tempo_estimado.observacao: Estimate for learner pilot. Video and transcript are alternatives; do not count both.

aulas.objetivo: Identify the components, explain one exclusion and write an acceptance condition for setup.

checagem.pergunta: Which statement is a verifiable setup commitment?
alternativas: Revenue will double.
Every employee will love the product.
Two accounts will complete the agreed test workflow.
checagem.feedback: The test checks delivery against scope. Future revenue and universal approval are not guaranteed setup outcomes.

roteiro_video.fala_instrutor: A small business buying a laptop online is still making a business purchase. The website does not tell us who uses the product, who approves spending or what process applies. In the Cedar case, a service adviser tests the workflow and the owner approves investment. Someone else may review the agreement. Ask about those roles without assuming every US business buys in the same way. Our historical Census example also requires care: a share of retail sales is not a seller’s chance of winning a deal. Pause and map the actual participants.
roteiro_video.gravacao: Not recorded; deliver as a short lesson with explicit exercise pauses.

aulas.texto_apoio: B2B and B2C distinguish buying relationships, not fixed personalities. A business buyer can have emotional concerns; an individual can use a detailed comparison. Map users, technical or operational evaluators, economic approvers and contracting responsibilities. One person may hold several roles. Source S1 is a historical US retail estimate, not an India market statistic and not a conversion benchmark. Its published edition reported a 2024 online retail share of 16.1% and carries a later-revision notice. Check coverage and edition before drawing a conclusion.

exemplo.conteudo: Cedar’s adviser will use the system; the owner approves spending; contract review is not mapped.

instrucoes: Map three buying roles and write the question needed to identify the contracting process. Explain why a retail share does not predict a deal outcome.
exercicio.entrega: Written response using only fictional details.
exercicio.gabarito: User: adviser; economic approver: owner; contracting reviewer: unknown. Ask who reviews terms and signs. Retail channel share measures a different population and outcome.
exercicio.justificativa: Mapping use, evaluation and approval helps identify missing contracting responsibilities. An aggregate US retail measure cannot predict the outcome of a particular account.

tempo_estimado.observacao: Estimate for learner pilot. Video and transcript are alternatives; do not count both.

aulas.objetivo: Map three buying roles and write the question needed to identify the contracting process. Explain why a retail share does not predict a deal outcome.

checagem.pergunta: Does an online order automatically identify a consumer purchase?
alternativas: No; buyer and use context still matter.
Yes; all website orders are B2C.
Yes; B2B requires an in-person visit.
checagem.feedback: A business can order online. Channel does not identify the participants, purpose or approval process.

aulas.titulo: SDR, BDR, closer, salesperson and sales manager

roteiro_video.fala_instrutor: Job titles vary. In one US team an SDR handles inbound qualification; in another the role includes outbound work. BDR may mean new-account development, and an account executive may own negotiation and closing. Do not use a title to override the actual assignment. A useful handoff gives the next person confirmed context, unresolved questions and a buyer-accepted next step. “Hot lead” does none of that. Pause and replace that label with four factual lines about Cedar Auto, including what has not been verified.
roteiro_video.gravacao: Not recorded; deliver as a short lesson with explicit exercise pauses.
roteiro_video.tela: SDR, BDR, closer, salesperson and sales manager

aulas.texto_apoio: Specify responsibilities, output quality and handoff conditions. Initial qualification should produce reliable context, while negotiation must stay within delegated authority. Managers should review both activity and quality. Source S2 reports a 70% share of time on non-selling tasks in its surveyed sales-rep data. The report’s overall survey covered 5,500 sales professionals in 27 countries in March–April 2024; the overall sample is not necessarily the denominator for every chart. It is a vendor-published self-report, not a universal target or evidence that all administration is waste.

exemplo.conteudo: An SDR records “hot lead” after Cedar asks for a brochure; the next rep assumes a buying project exists.

instrucoes: Rewrite the handoff and choose one quality measure with an explicit denominator.
exercicio.entrega: Written response using only fictional details.
exercicio.gabarito: Brochure requested; buying purpose, participants and timing unconfirmed; next action is to clarify the request through the approved channel. Track held meetings meeting the stated criteria divided by held meetings reviewed, for a defined period.
exercicio.justificativa: The revised handoff reports an observable request and preserves gaps. A quality measure needs both a defined outcome and the denominator against which it is reviewed.

tempo_estimado.observacao: Estimate for learner pilot. Video and transcript are alternatives; do not count both.

aulas.objetivo: Rewrite the handoff and choose one quality measure with an explicit denominator.

checagem.pergunta: Your title says business development, but you do not have pricing authority. What governs your actions?
alternativas: A generic description found online.
The actual responsibilities and delegated authority of the assignment.
Whatever commitment produces the fastest reply.
checagem.feedback: A job title does not create authority to approve terms. Clarify the actual assignment and handoff conditions.

roteiro_video.fala_instrutor: “We want something modern” is not yet a specification. Cedar’s owner might mean mobile access, a simpler screen or fewer repeated entries. Ask what should become possible and what would count as a useful improvement. Avoid making the difficulty sound bigger than the owner describes. If the impact has not been measured, write “not measured”. Pause and turn a vague preference into a question about an observable task. A good question leaves room for the answer to change your recommendation.
roteiro_video.gravacao: Not recorded; deliver as a short lesson with explicit exercise pauses.

aulas.texto_apoio: A need concerns what must be addressed; a preference describes a desired form; a difficulty is an experienced obstacle; an expectation is a condition against which the buyer may judge delivery. These categories overlap and should help the conversation rather than diagnose the person. Ask for a recent example and an acceptable improvement. Not every impact must be monetised. If using a calculation, distinguish a hypothetical estimate from observed results and explain assumptions, implementation costs and what may not be recoverable as cash.

exemplo.conteudo: Cedar wants a cleaner screen, fewer duplicate entries and a trial that does not interrupt the service desk.

instrucoes: Identify one preference, one need and one expectation. Write a question for each and mark one condition you cannot promise.
exercicio.entrega: Written response using only fictional details.
exercicio.gabarito: Cleaner screen: preference. Checking duplicate records: task need to confirm. Non-disruptive trial: expectation requiring planning. Ask what staff must do and what time window is feasible; do not promise zero disruption.
exercicio.justificativa: The answer separates form preference from an operational need and an implementation expectation. It marks an unverified condition instead of promising an effortless change.

tempo_estimado.observacao: Estimate for learner pilot. Video and transcript are alternatives; do not count both.

aulas.objetivo: Identify one preference, one need and one expectation. Write a question for each and mark one condition you cannot promise.

checagem.pergunta: The buyer wants a modern system. Does that establish a need for AI?
alternativas: Yes; modern always means AI.
Only if there is a discount.
No; clarify the task and success condition.
checagem.feedback: A vague preference is not a requirement for a specific technology. Discover the task first.

roteiro_video.fala_instrutor: Our fictional product supports a single location with up to five users. A twenty-location chain may have a similar problem and still be outside this offer. Build a profile using operational fit, not assumptions about someone’s personal life. A public business page is a research source, not a blanket permission for any outreach. Check the organisation’s approved data and channel process. Pause and label each account fit, not fit or investigate, and keep unknown information visible.
roteiro_video.gravacao: Not recorded; deliver as a short lesson with explicit exercise pauses.

aulas.texto_apoio: An ideal customer profile describes account characteristics associated with potential fit. A buyer persona concerns a role and context in the decision. Neither proves purchase intent. Separate required fit conditions from tentative prioritisation signals and explicit exclusions. Record source, date and uncertainty. Unknown is a valid status. Privacy and outreach approval are separate checks from product fit; route legal questions to the responsible team. The India DPDP framework and relevant channel rules require review of applicability and effective provisions, not a claim that one generic script establishes compliance.

exemplo.conteudo: A: one location, three users. B: ten locations. C: location count unknown, four users. D: one location, previous stop-contact request.

instrucoes: Classify A–D, justify with product scope and contact restrictions, and name the minimum data needed.
exercicio.entrega: Written response using only fictional details.
exercicio.gabarito: A: investigate need; B: outside stated scope; C: investigate location count; D: do not contact. Keep account ID, fit facts, source/date, uncertainty and authorised action.
exercicio.justificativa: The classification uses stated scope and distinguishes unknown from incompatible. It also recognises that a matching account can still be excluded from contact.

tempo_estimado.observacao: Estimate for learner pilot. Video and transcript are alternatives; do not count both.

aulas.objetivo: Classify A–D, justify with product scope and contact restrictions, and name the minimum data needed.

checagem.pergunta: An account matches the product but has asked for no contact. What applies?
alternativas: Respect the restriction rather than add it to outreach.
Product fit cancels the stop request.
Try a different sender.
checagem.feedback: Product fit and contact permission are separate decisions. Do not evade the restriction.

roteiro_video.fala_instrutor: Start broad, ask for an example, then confirm what you understood. “How do work orders arrive?” invites description. “Where did the last duplicate appear?” explores an episode. “Was that a telephone order?” verifies a detail. Do not ask five questions at once or imply a financial loss that the buyer never reported. At Cedar, “How much money are you losing every day?” would assume both loss and daily frequency. Pause and replace it with a neutral question about what happens after a duplicate entry.
roteiro_video.gravacao: Not recorded; deliver as a short lesson with explicit exercise pauses.

aulas.texto_apoio: Use question types for different purposes. Open questions uncover context; probes develop a specific point; closed questions verify facts. A neutral sequence is context → recent example → consequence → confirmation. Questions about authority, resources or timing should help assess a path, not create an interrogation. Avoid leading phrasing, false alternatives and implied threats. If an answer is unavailable, record the gap. Do not ask for sensitive documents to make a basic qualification form appear complete.

exemplo.conteudo: Cedar says a work order “sometimes goes missing”; the rep assumes a daily financial loss.

instrucoes: Write one open question, one probe and one confirmation. Identify the unsupported inference.
exercicio.entrega: Written response using only fictional details.
exercicio.gabarito: How do you track orders? Can you describe the last missing entry? Is the immediate goal to locate each order before work starts? Daily frequency and financial loss are not established.
exercicio.justificativa: The question sequence gathers context and a concrete episode, then invites correction. It leaves frequency and impact unconfirmed when the buyer has not measured them.

tempo_estimado.observacao: Estimate for learner pilot. Video and transcript are alternatives; do not count both.

aulas.objetivo: Write one open question, one probe and one confirmation. Identify the unsupported inference.

checagem.pergunta: Which question avoids assuming a financial loss?
alternativas: How much money do you lose every day?
What happens when an order cannot be located?
Do you agree your team is failing?
checagem.feedback: The second question explores a consequence without imposing amount, frequency or blame.

roteiro_video.fala_instrutor: Listening changes what you do next. If Cedar’s owner says they are not replacing software and only need help finding an existing status screen, do not continue a replacement pitch. Summarise without exaggeration: “The immediate issue is finding information in the current process; have I understood?” Leave room for correction. If asked to stop marketing contact, stop and use the approved preference-recording process. Pause for a four-minute role-play and four-minute review, focusing on one example of your response changing after new information.
roteiro_video.gravacao: Not recorded; deliver as a short lesson with explicit exercise pauses.

aulas.texto_apoio: A faithful paraphrase preserves meaning and certainty. “May consider” does not mean “will purchase”. Confirm a summary and allow the buyer to correct it. Prefer observable notes to character judgements: “wants to verify compatibility” rather than “difficult buyer”. Do not score intelligence or interest from accent, response speed or cultural assumptions. Use only fictional data in role-play. Stop requests and privacy requests follow the organisation’s approved procedures; a rep should not promise deletion or a legal outcome without checking the applicable process.

exemplo.conteudo: The buyer says: “Maybe next quarter, but please stop marketing messages for now.”

instrucoes: Paraphrase faithfully, choose the immediate action and perform the formative role-play.
exercicio.entrega: Written response using only fictional details.
exercicio.gabarito: Future review is possible, not confirmed. Stop marketing messages and record the preference through the approved process; do not treat a future possibility as automatic permission.
exercicio.justificativa: A faithful summary retains both uncertain future interest and a definite present restriction. The chosen action respects the restriction instead of upgrading politeness into consent.

tempo_estimado.observacao: Estimate for learner pilot. Video and transcript are alternatives; do not count both.

aulas.objetivo: Paraphrase faithfully, choose the immediate action and perform the formative role-play.

checagem.pergunta: The buyer asks for marketing messages to stop. Which response demonstrates listening?
alternativas: Send a final discount first.
Change channel to test the request.
Stop the contact and record the preference through the approved process.
checagem.feedback: Listening must change the action. A stop request cannot be treated as an invitation to try another pitch.

roteiro_video.fala_instrutor: Before sending anything, decide who could plausibly use the offer, what data you are allowed to use and which question you need to answer. A large list is not automatically useful. For Cedar-type accounts, record fit facts, source date and an authorised next action. A company expanding may be worth investigating, but expansion does not prove budget or urgency. Pause and select one account for investigation, one to exclude and one you must not contact because of its recorded preference.
roteiro_video.gravacao: Not recorded; deliver as a short lesson with explicit exercise pauses.

aulas.texto_apoio: Keep an initial list small enough to inspect. Useful fields are account identifier, relevant fit facts, source/date, uncertainty, authorised channel and known restrictions. Remove duplicates and do not reuse data from another campaign without the approved basis and procedure. To review research quality, define a measure such as accounts meeting fit criteria divided by accounts reviewed during a stated period. That measure is about a specified sample and rule, not a guaranteed conversion rate for the entire market.

exemplo.conteudo: A single-site shop fits; a ten-site chain does not fit the stated product; a fitting shop has asked for no contact.

instrucoes: Choose an action for each account and write a prospecting objective that does not assume purchase intent.
exercicio.entrega: Written response using only fictional details.
exercicio.gabarito: Investigate the first shop’s actual workflow, exclude the chain from this offer, respect the stop request. Objective: check whether the supported workflow addresses a confirmed difficulty.
exercicio.justificativa: The plan excludes unsupported scope and prohibited outreach while retaining a legitimate investigation objective. It does not treat a public signal as proven purchase intent.

tempo_estimado.observacao: Estimate for learner pilot. Video and transcript are alternatives; do not count both.

aulas.objetivo: Choose an action for each account and write a prospecting objective that does not assume purchase intent.

checagem.pergunta: Which research output supports a responsible next decision?
alternativas: Fit facts, source/date, gaps and an authorised action.
The largest possible collection of telephone numbers.
A guess about the owner’s personal wealth.
checagem.feedback: A focused record supports a relevant decision without unnecessary personal data. Volume alone does not establish quality.

aulas.titulo: Opening a conversation with a clear purpose

roteiro_video.fala_instrutor: An inbound opening can refer to a request only when that request exists. “I’m Alex from Order Desk; you asked for information about work-order tracking. May I ask two questions to check fit?” is different from unsolicited outreach. Never write “following our meeting” to someone you have not met. For US commercial email, the FTC guide covers truthful identity and subject lines and an opt-out mechanism; its rules also address B2B messages. This lesson is not a complete email-compliance checklist. Pause and draft an inbound opening using the real source of interest.
roteiro_video.gravacao: Not recorded; deliver as a short lesson with explicit exercise pauses.
roteiro_video.tela: Opening a conversation with a clear purpose

aulas.texto_apoio: A useful structure is identity → truthful context → relevant hypothesis → small request. Personalisation should explain relevance, not expose personal information. No reply is not a statement of interest and does not justify unlimited attempts. Do not use deceptive thread prefixes or invented prior relationships. Channel requirements are additional to clear writing. Use the organisation’s reviewed templates and preference process; do not treat one model sentence as proof that a campaign is legally compliant.

exemplo.conteudo: Cedar submitted an enquiry form. A second fictional account has made no request; any outreach would need separate operational approval.

instrucoes: Write an inbound opening and explain which claim must be removed from an active-contact version.
exercicio.entrega: Written response using only fictional details.
exercicio.gabarito: Hi, I’m Alex from Order Desk. We received your request about work-order tracking. May I ask how you record orders today? Remove any reference to a request from an account that never made one.
exercicio.justificativa: The inbound version identifies the real source of interest. An active-contact version must remove nonexistent requests or referrals and requires its own approved channel process.

tempo_estimado.observacao: Estimate for learner pilot. Video and transcript are alternatives; do not count both.

aulas.objetivo: Write an inbound opening and explain which claim must be removed from an active-contact version.

alternativas: Replying to a form enquiry that actually exists.
Following our meeting, when no meeting occurred.
Introducing the company and asking about relevance through an approved process.
checagem.feedback: The meeting reference invents a prior relationship. Context must remain truthful even if a different wording gets more replies.

roteiro_video.fala_instrutor: “Send information” is a response, not a confirmed buying project. Cedar reports duplicate entries and wants to see a workflow, but the contact has not explained approvals or budget. Keep those gaps visible. Ask how an investment of this kind is evaluated and who should be involved. You may classify the case as under investigation if the operation’s rules allow it; do not label it approved. Pause and separate confirmed facts, unknowns and the next question.
roteiro_video.gravacao: Not recorded; deliver as a short lesson with explicit exercise pauses.

aulas.texto_apoio: Define qualification before counting outcomes. An operation may require a confirmed problem, basic fit, an appropriate participant and an accepted next step. Follow the actual rule rather than mechanically applying an acronym. Need does not imply priority; influence does not equal signing authority; interest does not prove available resources. Record the reason for the stage and the next authorised action. If there is no fit, say so and close or refer through an available process without fabricating urgency.

exemplo.conteudo: Cedar confirms duplicate entries, interest in a demo and owner approval authority; resources and meeting details are unknown.

instrucoes: List facts, unknowns and two qualification questions. Do not use hot/cold labels.
exercicio.entrega: Written response using only fictional details.
exercicio.gabarito: Facts: problem, demo interest and owner role. Unknowns: funding process and accepted slot. Ask how approval works and which next step the owner wants to take.
exercicio.justificativa: Qualification separates confirmed need and interest from resources and timing. The next questions target the actual gaps rather than filling fields with convenient assumptions.

tempo_estimado.observacao: Estimate for learner pilot. Video and transcript are alternatives; do not count both.

aulas.objetivo: List facts, unknowns and two qualification questions. Do not use hot/cold labels.

checagem.pergunta: The contact does not know the budget. How should you record it?
alternativas: Approved.
Zero.
Unknown, with an appropriate approval-process question.
checagem.feedback: No amount stated is neither an approval nor proof of zero funding. The next task is to understand the process.

roteiro_video.fala_instrutor: Show the workflow linked to the buyer’s confirmed need, then ask whether it meets the stated test. Do not turn a demo into a guarantee of revenue. If Cedar asks for a 30% discount and you have no authority, explain that you can clarify the concern and consult the responsible person without promising approval. Check term, seats and included services before comparing prices. Pause and propose a next step with an owner and condition, rather than saying “I’ll send something”.
roteiro_video.gravacao: Not recorded; deliver as a short lesson with explicit exercise pauses.

aulas.texto_apoio: Make a recommendation traceable: confirmed problem → relevant capability → available evidence → limitation → acceptance check. Compare offers on the same basis, including term, seats, dependencies and exclusions. Negotiation concerns authorised variables, not improvised commitments. A clear next step names action, responsible person, condition or date and buyer acceptance. Formal agreement requires the applicable authorisations and contracting process; compliments, proposal requests and demo attendance do not establish purchase on their own.

exemplo.conteudo: Cedar requests an unauthorised discount before the owner has reviewed the migration scope.

instrucoes: Reply to the discount request, identify one unresolved condition and write a next step.
exercicio.entrega: Written response using only fictional details.
exercicio.gabarito: I can understand the constraint and ask the authorised owner to review options, without promising a concession. First confirm migration scope; send it for owner review through the agreed channel.
exercicio.justificativa: The reply preserves pricing authority and identifies the unresolved scope or quote basis. A valid next step needs a responsible owner and an agreed condition, not an assumed purchase.

tempo_estimado.observacao: Estimate for learner pilot. Video and transcript are alternatives; do not count both.

aulas.objetivo: Reply to the discount request, identify one unresolved condition and write a next step.

checagem.pergunta: When is a purchase appropriately recorded as formalised?
alternativas: When the applicable contracting process and required approvals are complete.
When the buyer compliments a demo.
When an unauthorised discount is offered.
checagem.feedback: Interest and a proposal request do not, by themselves, establish a formal agreement.

roteiro_video.fala_instrutor: The handoff after agreement must preserve scope and unresolved issues. If Cedar cannot access an account, the first action is to route and track the access problem, not announce a success story. Invite an optional referral only at an appropriate point and through the approved process; support is not conditional on giving you other people’s contact details. Now reserve twelve minutes for the twenty-question knowledge check. Review each explanation afterwards. A theoretical pass does not, by itself, demonstrate a complete practical conversation.
roteiro_video.gravacao: Not recorded; deliver as a short lesson with explicit exercise pauses.

aulas.texto_apoio: After-sales work verifies delivery, clarifies use within scope and tracks problems to an appropriate owner. Do not conceal a service issue to protect a sales metric or use a complaint to pressure an additional purchase. Check the buyer’s agreed success condition and record what actually happened. Testimonials, images and referrals need the relevant permissions and approved process. The course’s pass threshold is 16/20, which is 80%; this is a learning rule, not a market statistic. The quiz time is included in this lesson and must not be added again.

exemplo.conteudo: One of Cedar’s two accounts cannot sign in; a salesperson wants to publish a case study before the issue is resolved.

instrucoes: Prioritise actions, draft an after-sales reply and complete the knowledge check.
exercicio.entrega: Written response using only fictional details.
exercicio.gabarito: Route the access issue, confirm resolution and delivery, then consider an optional referral at an appropriate time. Say what you will check and who owns the response; do not announce success yet.
exercicio.justificativa: The response prioritises the existing delivery obligation and avoids claiming success while a material problem remains. Support must not depend on supplying new leads.

tempo_estimado.observacao: Estimate for learner pilot. Video and transcript are alternatives; do not count both.

aulas.objetivo: Prioritise actions, draft an after-sales reply and complete the knowledge check.

checagem.pergunta: What should precede announcing a successful implementation?
alternativas: A request for mandatory referrals.
Confirmation that delivery occurred and relevant problems were handled.
Automatic publication of a testimonial.
checagem.feedback: A public success claim must not substitute for verifying delivery. Optional referrals do not resolve access issues.

aulas.titulo: Reading RYCS campaigns and commercial opportunities

roteiro_video.fala_instrutor: A training example is not a live RYCS offer. Before acting on an opportunity, read the objective, target profile, required activity, acceptance conditions and permitted evidence. Commercial terms and availability may vary. In our fictional assignment, a held meeting is required. An accepted invitation is not the same outcome. Check the live dashboard and applicable terms for actual conditions, and ask the responsible team about gaps. Pause and distinguish activity, evidence and review without assuming a payment amount.
roteiro_video.gravacao: Not recorded; deliver as a short lesson with explicit exercise pauses.
roteiro_video.tela: Reading RYCS campaigns and commercial opportunities

aulas.texto_apoio: Prepare a reading sheet: objective, target account, activity, acceptance rule, permitted evidence, restrictions, query owner and stated commercial conditions. Distinguish execution deadlines, review timing and any payment-release conditions; do not invent values or dates. This material teaches interpretation rather than the current legal or payment rules of RYCS. Product owners must verify screens and workflows before recording. Do not use real contacts or perform a live campaign merely to complete the fictional exercise.

exemplo.conteudo: Fictional assignment: a held meeting with a responsible single-location shop contact and a compatible need. Payment and review dates are not provided.

instrucoes: Fill in known conditions, list at least three gaps and explain why the example cannot support an earnings calculation.
exercicio.entrega: Written response using only fictional details.
exercicio.gabarito: Target and outcome are partly defined; value, dates and exact evidence process need confirmation. There is no basis for a payment calculation.
exercicio.justificativa: The reading sheet distinguishes the work requirement from missing evidence and commercial conditions. No payment calculation is supportable without the actual terms.

tempo_estimado.observacao: Estimate for learner pilot. Video and transcript are alternatives; do not count both.

aulas.objetivo: Fill in known conditions, list at least three gaps and explain why the example cannot support an earnings calculation.

checagem.pergunta: Where should actual RYCS opportunity conditions be checked?
alternativas: In any fictional classroom example.
In another learner’s income claim.
In the live opportunity instructions and applicable terms.
checagem.feedback: Training examples do not establish availability, eligibility or payment conditions for a real opportunity.

aulas.titulo: Turning task instructions into acceptance checks

roteiro_video.fala_instrutor: “Qualified meeting held” contains multiple requirements. Did the meeting happen? Did the participant meet the stated role criterion? Was the relevant problem confirmed? Is the required next step documented? An invitation addresses only scheduling. Turn each requirement into a check linked to a permitted source. If instructions conflict, ask for clarification rather than choosing the version that produces the highest count. Pause and mark each condition confirmed, pending or not met based only on the available evidence.
roteiro_video.gravacao: Not recorded; deliver as a short lesson with explicit exercise pauses.
roteiro_video.tela: Turning task instructions into acceptance checks

aulas.texto_apoio: Separate mandatory criteria, useful context and hypotheses. Quantity cannot compensate for a missing mandatory condition. A review matrix links requirement → permitted verification → source → status. A record supports only the event it actually establishes. If evidence is unavailable or collection is inappropriate, preserve the uncertainty and contact the responsible owner. Do not rewrite the assignment’s requirements inside your report to make the activity appear valid.

exemplo.conteudo: Only an invitation accepted by an assistant exists. The requirement is a held meeting with an operationally responsible participant and confirmed need.

instrucoes: Build the requirement matrix and write one question about the contact’s role.
exercicio.entrega: Written response using only fictional details.
exercicio.gabarito: Invite acceptance confirmed; attendance, relevant responsibility, need and meeting next step pending. Ask who owns the workflow and should participate in its evaluation.
exercicio.justificativa: The matrix prevents a scheduling record from satisfying unrelated requirements. A participant’s title is not a substitute for confirming the operational role the task requires.

tempo_estimado.observacao: Estimate for learner pilot. Video and transcript are alternatives; do not count both.

aulas.objetivo: Build the requirement matrix and write one question about the contact’s role.

checagem.pergunta: Does an accepted invitation, by itself, prove a meeting was held?
alternativas: No; scheduling acceptance and attendance are different events.
Yes; an accepted calendar invite proves every requirement.
Yes; renaming the file is enough.
checagem.feedback: Evidence must support the specific event. An accepted invitation cannot establish attendance or the quality of the meeting.

roteiro_video.fala_instrutor: “Great call, sure to close” is an opinion, not a useful record. Write what happened, when, the result and the accepted next step. Cedar asked for scope to review with the owner; that does not mean the owner approved a purchase. Use only permitted evidence and the minimum information needed. Never alter a screenshot to invent attendance or reuse another activity’s evidence. Pause and rewrite an enthusiastic note as a factual record with one explicit unknown.
roteiro_video.gravacao: Not recorded; deliver as a short lesson with explicit exercise pauses.

aulas.texto_apoio: Evidence needs authenticity, relevance, clarity and data minimisation. An invitation supports scheduling, not automatic attendance or payment approval. Before recording or sharing a conversation, check the applicable rules and approved procedure; this course grants no general recording permission. Preserve correction history through the available workflow. Record only what the event supports, maintain access restrictions and use the organisation’s incident process for accidental exposure rather than redistributing the material.

exemplo.conteudo: Available facts: Tuesday call at 10:00 local time; the buyer requested scope for owner review; decision date unknown.

instrucoes: Write a factual note and identify two unsupported claims or unnecessary data items to exclude.
exercicio.entrega: Written response using only fictional details.
exercicio.gabarito: Tuesday, 10:00 local: scope requested for owner review; no buying decision or deadline confirmed; send scope by agreed channel. Exclude “certain sale” and unrelated personal data.
exercicio.justificativa: The rewritten note distinguishes a request from a decision and removes certainty unsupported by the event. Minimisation excludes personal data that the task does not require.

tempo_estimado.observacao: Estimate for learner pilot. Video and transcript are alternatives; do not count both.

aulas.objetivo: Write a factual note and identify two unsupported claims or unnecessary data items to exclude.

alternativas: A screenshot edited to add a nonexistent meeting.
Facts, unknowns and traceable corrections through the approved process.
Evidence copied from another task.
checagem.feedback: Record integrity requires a truthful relationship to the activity and an appropriate correction trail.

aulas.titulo: Review outcomes, commissions and platform rules

roteiro_video.fala_instrutor: Submission, acceptance and payment are different events. If a fictional review says your evidence only shows scheduling and the meeting was postponed, report that fact. Changing a file title does not make the meeting happen. Check actual terms for commissions and review routes; course completion does not guarantee work or income. Now spend six minutes on the final conversation and six on the record and rubric. The practical model needs integration and review: the current platform’s theoretical certificate does not prove that this role-play was assessed.
roteiro_video.gravacao: Not recorded; deliver as a short lesson with explicit exercise pauses.
roteiro_video.tela: Review outcomes, commissions and platform rules

aulas.texto_apoio: Read the stated review reason and use the available clarification or correction process. Never manufacture evidence. Compensation depends on actual opportunity conditions and valid work; training examples establish no entitlement or earnings promise. The proposed completion model requires all lessons, at least 16/20 on theory and at least 80/100 on the practical rubric without a critical ethical failure. Practical gating is not implemented in the existing platform. Keep the package marked for review until pedagogy, product, privacy, localisation and integration have been checked.

exemplo.conteudo: Review says “attendance not evidenced”. You know Cedar postponed the meeting and has not held it.

instrucoes: Write a factual response, choose the correction and complete the final role-play and handoff.
exercicio.entrega: Written response using only fictional details.
exercicio.gabarito: The attachment shows scheduling only; the meeting was postponed. Correct the status using the available process and do not claim a held meeting. Apply the rubric to the actual fictional transcript.
exercicio.justificativa: A postponed meeting cannot be reported as completed. The final project assesses observed conduct and factual recording; disputed or insufficient AI evidence requires human review.

tempo_estimado.observacao: Estimate for learner pilot. Video and transcript are alternatives; do not count both.

aulas.objetivo: Write a factual response, choose the correction and complete the final role-play and handoff.

alternativas: Yes, if all questions are correct.
Yes, if an AI actor likes the conversation.
No; work and remuneration depend on actual opportunity conditions.
